# Underwriting Memo

**Risk summary**

Zelvane Inns operates limited-service hotels without restaurants across three locations in Savannah, GA. Total insured value is $7,870,000. The account is classified as HOTL (Hotel/Motel). All locations are inland (14.8–19.1 km from coast). The broker is Wexmoor Agency (Core) with a fit score of 60.

**Appetite and referral**

This submission requires referral per **AG-007**: class HOTL mandates senior underwriter review with maximum $30M TIV per account. The account falls within this limit. Territory is acceptable under **AG-014** (Southeast inland). Five-year incurred losses exceed $250K ($299,900 total), triggering additional referral requirements per appetite guidelines.

**Loss history**

Seven claims over five years with total incurred losses of $299,900. Loss activity concentrated in 2022–2023 (water damage $121,100; theft $129,800). No claims reported in 2024–2025. All claims are closed. Loss ratio trends warrant review of property protection and security measures.

**Exposure and concentration**

Portfolio concentration risk exists: $51.7M TIV already written within 25 km of these locations. Adding $7.9M increases local accumulation to $59.6M.

**Recommendation**

Suggest referral to senior underwriter per **AG-007**. Request loss control reports addressing water damage prevention and theft mitigation before binding.
